sop: SOP-PR-021 Equipment cleaning and use log (synthetic)

ranking.title: 211.46 Ventilation, air filtration, air heating and cooling.

rows.text: Equipment and utensils shall be cleaned, maintained, and, as appropriate for the nature of the drug, sanitized and/or sterilized at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunctions or contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To define how manufacturing equipment is cleaned, maintained and sanitized between batches and between products, and how cleaning and use are recorded, at the Chennai tablet plant.

4. Cleaning

4.1 Each machine has a written cleaning instruction naming who cleans it, the schedule, the detergent and its concentration, the method and the equipment used, and how parts are taken apart and put back together. 4.2 A machine is cleaned after every batch and before any change of product. 4.3 Clean equipment is tagged with the date and time of cleaning and protected from contamination before use. 4.4 Equipment is inspected for cleanliness by the supervisor immediately before use.

5. Maintenance

Preventive maintenance follows the schedule in the maintenance plan. Punches and dies are inspected for wear at every change of tooling. Lubricants must not come into contact with product.

rows.text: Written procedures shall be established and followed for cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To define how manufacturing equipment is cleaned, maintained and sanitized between batches and between products, and how cleaning and use are recorded, at the Chennai tablet plant.

4. Cleaning

Every major machine has a bound cleaning and use log. Each entry gives the date, the product and batch number processed, the cleaning or maintenance done, and the initials of the person who did it and of the person who checked it. Entries are made in chronological order.
